Read-only identity copies through a private pasteboard during loading. Controlled continuation queues empty on successful completion.

Fresh-dialog later changes use actual Git defaults. This does not execute a real rebase/squash engine or prove every date policy.

Run after main transition changes and before Replay-only preset refinement; final metadata receiver exercises both ordinary and Replay paths after refinement.
